display.purpose: Hero statement on full-bleed imagery. Signal White over dimmed photography only.

headline.purpose: Major section title blocks on blue-gray panels. The heaviest type on a light surface.

body.purpose: Running prose. Hold to 65-75 characters per line.

label.purpose: Nav links, CTA labels, and the navy description eyebrow.

motion.name: nav-slide
motion.purpose: Navbar hides on scroll-down and reappears on scroll-up.

motion.name: menu-morph
motion.purpose: Hamburger bars morph into an X; mobile menu slides in from the left.

motion.name: hero-fade
motion.purpose: A Dock White overlay fades in over the hero as the user scrolls past it.

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Continuous customer-logo auto-scroll on the home page. Needs a reduced-motion fallback.

components.css: .ds-navbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 2rem; padding: 0 8%; height: 5.938rem; background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.20), rgba(0,0,0,0.20)), #204782; font-family: 'Archivo', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-navbar__brand { color: #fff; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-navbar__links { display: flex; gap: 2rem; } .ds-navbar__links a { color: #fff; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.15rem; } .ds-navbar__links a:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-navbar__links a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Primary CTA
components.description: Page-level contact call-to-action. Navy Hull Shadow fill, fixed footprint.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 10rem; height: 3rem; background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.20), rgba(0,0,0,0.20)), #204782; color: #fff; font-family: 'Archivo', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.1rem; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.12); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0D2954; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Language Toggle
components.description: Persistent circular control, bottom-right, cycles EN / ID / ZH.
components.css: .ds-lang-toggle { width: 4rem; height: 4rem; border-radius: 100%; background: #0D2954; color: #fff; border: none; font-family: 'Archivo', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.2s; } .ds-lang-toggle:hover { filter: brightness(1.2); } .ds-lang-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Contact-form field. White ground, 1px hairline, square corners.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 2rem; width: 100%; padding: 0 0.625rem; background: #fff; color: #0D2954; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.2); border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Archivo', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5a6a82; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #204782; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(32,71,130,0.25); }

components.name: Section Title Block
components.description: The brand's section signature: a blue-gray title panel paired with a navy accent bar.
components.css: .ds-section-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; width: 100%; } .ds-section-title__panel { background: #B7C2D4; color: #0D2954; padding: 1.25rem 2rem; font-family: 'Archivo', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.2rem); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-section-title__line { flex: 1; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 2px; background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.20), rgba(0,0,0,0.20)), #204782; }

components.name: Customer Marquee
components.description: Continuous client-logo scroll. Proof-over-adjectives in motion; pauses under reduced motion.
components.css: .ds-marquee { overflow: hidden; width: 100%; padding: 1.5rem 0; } .ds-marquee__track { display: inline-flex; gap: 3rem; white-space: nowrap; animation: ds-marquee-scroll 18s linear infinite; } .ds-marquee__track span { font-family: 'Archivo', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #204782; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } @keyframes ds-marquee-scroll { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-50%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-marquee__track { animation: none; flex-wrap: wrap; white-space: normal; } }

narrative.overview: This is the visual language of a yard that has been building and repairing ships since 1982. It should feel steady, weighty, and dependable, the way a large vessel sits at anchor in deep water. The whole system orbits one deep maritime navy, set against a near-white dock and carried by a single industrial-grotesque voice with real heft. Authority comes from evidence, not decoration: full-bleed photographs of real hulls do the talking while the chrome stays out of the way. It rejects generic corporate brochureware, the flashy consumer-tech startup look, the cold purely-industrial spec sheet, and cluttered busy layouts.
keyCharacteristics: One deep navy carries the brand; everything else supports it.
A single industrial grotesque (Archivo) across the whole site, working through weight contrast.
Flat surfaces. Depth comes from imagery and tonal layering, never from shadow.
Full-bleed 100vh hero photography on every page, dimmed so type can sit on it.
Asymmetric image showcases, not uniform card grids.
A repeating section signature: navy accent bar plus blue-gray title block.

rules.name: The Hull Shadow Rule
rules.body: Navy surfaces carry a 20% black multiply layered over #204782 (linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.20), rgba(0,0,0,0.20)), #204782). This recurring treatment on the navbar, footer, CTAs, accent bars, and map panel is the brand signature. Do not swap in a flat fill or a decorative multi-stop gradient.

rules.name: The One Navy Rule
rules.body: Exactly one brand navy (Deep Harbor Blue) and one deeper variant (Harbor Depth). No second blue, no teal, no accent hue. The restraint is the seriousness.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Family Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is built from Archivo's weight range (400 to 700), never from a second typeface.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Exception
rules.body: The small navy eyebrow above vessel and repair descriptions is a single deliberate pattern, not section scaffolding. Do not multiply it into a tracked uppercase kicker above every section.

rules.name: The Flat Hull Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Never add a decorative box-shadow to lift an element; use the navy Hull Shadow treatment or a contrasting blue-gray ground instead.

rules.name: The Brightness-Filter Rule
rules.body: Hero photographs are dimmed to roughly 75% brightness so Signal White display type stays legible. Verify contrast on the brightest region of the photo, not the average.

dos: Do carry the navy Hull Shadow treatment on every navy surface. It is the brand signature.
Do build type hierarchy from Archivo weight alone (400 to 700). One family, top to bottom.
Do keep surfaces flat and earn depth from full-bleed photography and the two blue-grays.
Do lead with real evidence: actual vessels, real client logos, the awards, the ISO certifications. Proof over adjectives.
Do hold body copy to 65 to 75 characters per line and set a visible :focus-visible ring on every interactive control.
Do give the customer marquee, the hide-on-scroll navbar, and the hero scroll-fade a prefers-reduced-motion alternative.
Do keep the EN / ID / ZH versions at visual and accessibility parity; a fix on one is a fix on all three.
donts: Don't ship generic corporate brochureware: no stock-business photography, no interchangeable icon-and-text card grids, no template layout.
Don't drift toward a flashy consumer-tech startup: no decorative multi-stop gradients, no playful illustration, no oversized rounded-everything.
Don't go cold and purely industrial: keep the family-craft story and the people visible.
Don't get cluttered and busy: one clear idea per view, generous spacing, an obvious path to contact.
Don't introduce a second brand hue beyond Deep Harbor Blue, Harbor Depth, and the blue-grays.
Don't add a box-shadow to lift an element; use the Hull Shadow or a blue-gray ground instead.
Don't set body or structural text below ~0.85rem. The current footer text (0.7rem) and copyright (0.5rem, 0.3rem on mobile) fail WCAG AA.
Don't use background-clip: text gradient headings, glassmorphism, or a border-left color stripe as an accent.
Don't multiply the navy eyebrow into a tracked uppercase kicker above every section.
